Back Pain in Jogeshwari — When Home Remedies Are Not Enough and a Doctor Is Needed

Back pain is one of the most common health complaints and is often caused by poor posture, muscle strain, prolonged sitting, or heavy lifting. While mild discomfort may improve with rest, stretching, and home remedies, persistent or severe back pain should not be ignored.

If your back pain lasts for more than a few weeks, keeps returning, interferes with daily activities, or becomes worse over time, it may indicate an underlying condition that requires medical attention. Symptoms such as pain radiating down the legs, numbness, tingling, weakness, or difficulty standing and walking should be evaluated by a specialist as soon as possible.

Common causes of chronic back pain include slipped discs, arthritis, spinal degeneration, nerve compression, and sports or workplace injuries. Early diagnosis can help prevent complications and improve recovery outcomes.

ECG Test in Jogeshwari — What It Detects and Why Doctors Recommend It

An Electrocardiogram (ECG) is one of the most commonly recommended heart tests and plays an important role in evaluating heart health. The test records the electrical activity of the heart and helps doctors identify potential cardiac problems quickly and non-invasively.

Doctors may recommend an ECG if a patient experiences symptoms such as chest pain, palpitations, shortness of breath, dizziness, or unexplained fatigue. The test can help detect irregular heart rhythms (arrhythmias), signs of a previous heart attack, reduced blood flow to the heart, and other abnormalities that may affect heart function.

An ECG is also commonly used as part of routine health screenings for individuals with high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, or a family history of heart disease. Early detection of heart-related issues allows for timely treatment and better long-term outcomes.

If you are experiencing heart-related symptoms or have risk factors for cardiovascular disease, consulting a cardiologist in Jogeshwari can help determine whether an ECG is required. Many heart conditions develop gradually and may not show clear symptoms in their early stages. That's why regular heart screenings are important, especially for individuals with risk factors such as high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, obesity, smoking, or a family history of heart disease. Consulting a cardiologist in Jogeshwari can help detect potential heart problems before they become serious.

A heart checkup is also recommended for people experiencing chest discomfort, shortness of breath, dizziness, heart palpitations, or unexplained fatigue. Adults over the age of 40 should consider periodic cardiac evaluations, while those with existing health conditions may require more frequent monitoring based on their doctor's advice.

Routine tests such as blood pressure monitoring, ECG, cholesterol screening, and other cardiac assessments can provide valuable insights into your heart health. Early diagnosis allows for timely treatment and lifestyle modifications that may help prevent future complications.

featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)
